description:
Move src/provider/anthropic.rs + src/provider/anthropic_adapter.rs + src/bin/lernie_provider_anthropic.rs into a new workspace member crates/lernie-provider-anthropic/.

=== Goals ===
- crates/lernie-provider-anthropic/ compiles independently of the root lernie crate.
- Drop the crate::config::{Auth, Provider} coupling: Client::from_provider is removed or moved to the binary layer. The adapter reads env vars directly per ARCH §4.4 (auth_env / endpoint_env); it does not parse lernie config.
- Root lernie crate no longer ships lernie-provider-anthropic as a [[bin]]. The workspace builds both via cargo build --workspace.
- Makefile INSTALL_BIN continues to install the binary (now from the subcrate's target).

=== Non-goals ===
- No streaming yet. This ball is a pure move + decouple; behavior identical.
- No harness-side decoupling (src/prompt/mod.rs still imports Response from the provider module; ball #2 fixes that).
title: Extract lernie-provider-anthropic to workspace crate
